selected_using: Only discovery seeds 30000-30007, never confirmation seeds
rationale: Unbounded count-gated return calibration averaged -164.15 on discovery MountainCar, versus static -206.39, dynamic -181.58, fixed return mixture -213.33 and plain -222.87. It also avoided the conspicuous raw-pheromone failures in grids. Limiting potential changes to 1 performed worse (-272.01), so the bounded alternative remains a negative ablation, not the selected proposal. Raw 50/50 mixing is a simpler secondary hypothesis (-163.87 on discovery MC), but performed badly in obstacle grids.
primary_family: 20 comparisons: selected proposal against return_static, return_dynamic, return_mix, plain and mc_dynamic, in each of four scenarios. Holm-adjust all 20 together.
secondary_family: 8 comparisons: raw_mix against raw_static and raw_dynamic in four scenarios. Mark secondary, adjust all 8, report alongside primary failures.
